description: This file defines the ResponsesIDSecurity class, a security hook for managing response IDs in a FastAPI-based proxy service. It handles encryption/decryption of response IDs, access control to responses based on user roles, and batch processing of response ID updates.

classes.name: ResponsesIDSecurity
classes.description: A security hook class that manages response ID encryption/decryption and access control to ensure user security in response handling.
